nameEn: Manufacture of air and spacecraft and related machinery
description: This class includes the manufacture of airplanes, helicopters, spacecraft and related machinery and equipment.
includes: manufacture of airplanes for the transport of goods or passengers
manufacture of military fighting airplanes and helicopters
manufacture of spacecraft and launch vehicles, satellites, planetary probes, orbital stations
manufacture of aircraft engines: turbojets, turboprops and other gas turbine engines
manufacture of aircraft parts and equipment: propellers, rotors, landing gear, fuel tanks, fuselage, wings
manufacture of parts and accessories for aircraft: navigation instruments, communication equipment
manufacture of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs / drones)
excludes: manufacture of aircraft instrumentation and navigation systems, see 2651
manufacture of ground flying trainers, see 2829
manufacture of military combat vehicles, see 3040
